text:
Jordan: Heads-up — I noticed ratecard v3.1 landed in staging and it added gated discounts for enterprise tiers. Customer POC (HealthTech) is asking for a 20% POC discount and wants the price lock for 6 months. Need quick clarity from deal desk and finance.
Priya: Ping @Aisha — can we fast-track a POC discount approval for this one? it's a low-risk pilot, $22k ARR if it converts.
Aisha (Deal Desk): We need commit term and whether this is a hosted or dedicated deployment. Also paste the customer company name and use-case. Without that, can't approve >15%.
Jordan: It's hosted, POC using our hosted API, company: Nimbel Health, use-case: triage assistant. They want price lock for 6 months post-POC.
Ravi (Finance): For hosted, our standard POC cap is 15% unless there's a multi-quarter commit. 20% would need SVP sales approval or swap to a short-term commit. Also need to understand avg monthly token volume to model impact.
Sam (Legal): No privacy/security red flags in the questionnaire so far. If they ask for data residency or audit logs we may need an addendum, but not required for the POC.
Connor (Product): Note that v3.1 changes the batching discount thresholds — quoting the older thresholds will under price us for high throughput POCs. Please confirm expected qps and sequence length distribution if possible.
Jordan: Quick numbers: estimate 15 rps during demo, avg seq len ~300 tokens. Not huge.
Aisha (Deal Desk): Given hosted + $22k, I'm willing to approve up to 15% POC discount. For 20% we need a one-month minimum committed spend or SVP sign-off. Can someone load a quote ID?
quote-bot: Quote created: Q-2026-0457 (expires in 7 days). Use code field: GATED-POC-APR-1955.
Priya: If we add a 1-month minimum commit (~$5k) can we get 20%? Customer prefers no commit but would consider it.
Linda (Deal Desk Manager): Approve temporary code flow: up to 15% immediate. If AE secures 1-month min commit, Deal Desk can escalate to 20% within same day. Document the rationale in the quote notes (POC -> healthtech, low infra risk).
Ravi (Finance): Add note: do not apply legacy bundling credits. This is a one-off POC price, track in monthly revenue reconciliations.
Jordan: I'll include the POC acceptance criteria and rollback clause. Also adding a short note in the quote: "pricing guaranteed for 6 months post-POC if customer signs within 30 days" — ok?
Sam (Legal): Wording OK as long as it's conditional on a signed order. Avoid implying SLA changes.
Connor (Product): Also flag for docs: we should add a blurb to the ratecard release notes explaining the gated discount behavior so AEs don't misquote.
Jordan: Thanks all. I'll finalize quote Q-2026-0457 with code GATED-POC-APR-1955 at 15% and push to the customer. Will ping if we need SVP escalation for 20%. :thumbsup:
Aisha (Deal Desk): Thanks — tagging @Linda for visibility. Please include the expected token burn estimate in the quote notes.
quote-bot: Quote updated: Q-2026-0457 — notes appended.
Priya: Customer asked if this applies to embeddings. Quick answer?
Ravi (Finance): POC discount applies to listed SKU lines on quote. If embeddings are a separate SKU, ensure it's listed. If they try to mix older embedding SKUs, we won't auto-apply.
Jordan: Copy. I'll list embeddings separately.
Linda (Deal Desk Manager): Final: 15% approved now. For any exceptions beyond that, route to me with clear justification and ARR uplift forecast.
Jordan: Great — closing the loop. Will post short follow-up when quote is sent. :white_check_mark:
